name: safari export report against an export bug and a dark mode bug

issue.title: Export button does nothing on Safari
issue.body: Clicked Export on the reports page in Safari 17. The page stayed still and no file arrived. Expected a CSV download.

candidates.title: CSV export finishes with no download in Safari 17
candidates.body: The CSV export on /reports completes with no file on Safari 17.2. Chrome downloads it.

candidates.title: Dark mode labels unreadable on the settings page
candidates.body: In dark mode the labels on the settings page are grey on grey.

name: a one line slowness report against two unrelated issues

issue.title: App is slow
issue.body: Everything has been slow since the update.

candidates.title: Invoice PDF misses the tax line
candidates.body: The generated invoice PDF leaves the VAT line out for customers in the EU.

candidates.title: Add a dark theme to the mobile app
candidates.body: Asking for a dark theme on iOS, the white background is hard on the eyes at night.

name: a login redirect against a session that drops mid-use

issue.title: Login redirects back to the login page
issue.body: Submitted the password on Chrome 128 and the browser returned to the login form. Expected the dashboard.

candidates.title: Session drops after a few minutes
candidates.body: Users are sent back to the login form in the middle of a session on Chrome, roughly every five minutes.

candidates.title: Search returns an empty list for tags
candidates.body: Searching by tag on the issues page returns nothing, while the same tag filter in the sidebar works.
